positive_findings: Four equal-radial-node shells and eight fixed angular bins reproduce the exact Stage-73 x-direction residual map within the frozen closure guard.
Shells 1 and 2 carry 99.90495306894647 percent of the pre-cancellation absolute residual magnitude.
The exact Stage-67 distributions and conservative 64-to-32-to-16 restriction were retained without a solver rerun.
negative_findings: The vertical-oblique opposite pairs retain 99.16925341428107 percent of their pre-pair absolute magnitude, so opposite-sector cancellation is weak rather than explanatory.
Radial-shell residual magnitude is not an adjoint sensitivity and does not predict a converged q_av response.
The failed Stage-28 MUSCL endpoint remains unrecovered and was not extended across Knudsen number.
No physical, collision, correction-floor, source-relaxation, transport, wall, normalization, or velocity-quadrature parameter was retuned.
